Work done by a body: This refers to the work done by the body on its surroundings,
often resulting in a decrease in its energy (e.g., kinetic energy).
Work done on a body: This refers to the work done on the body by an external force, often resulting in an increase in its energy (e.g., potential energy).
Work done by a body is the energy lost by the body and hence the work done is
negative while work done on a body is the energy gained by the body and hence
the work done is positive.

5.5 Energy
Energy is the capacity to do work. If work is performed, energy is expended, and if
energy is gained, an equivalent amount of work has been done.
There are many kinds of energy, with the main category being the division of energy
into mechanical energy and non-mechanical energy. Non-mechanical energies include
heat energy, sound energy, light energy, nuclear energy, etc. Here, we will discuss
mechanical energy, which is divided into two categories: kinetic energy and potential
energy. This distinction between mechanical and non-mechanical energy, as well as the
categorization of mechanical energy into kinetic and potential energy, aligns with
fundamental concepts in physics. Let's explore this breakdown further.
5.5.1 Mechanical Energy:

Kinetic energy: Imagine the following phenomena: i. You are sitting on the ground at some distance from your child (your nephew), who is playing nearby. You are suddenly informed that the child is playing with an explosive ball that is going to explode within a few minutes. What do you do then?
Physics, Grade 11 | 108

You run as fast as you can to save the child from the possible danger. All the energy within you is used up in running fast. This total energy within you is what we call Kinetic Energy. ii. You took part in a district-level race competition organized by your college. How did you run during your turn in the competition? Can you describe it? You definitely answer that you ran as fast as you could. Indeed, all the energy you possessed was converted into kinetic energy due to such a terrific race. iii. You are walking and talking with your friends. Some of the energy you possess is in the form of kinetic energy. iv. You are plowing the field. Here, you aren't utilizing all the energy. Part of the energy you are using is in the form of kinetic energy.
